source_limitations: Direct Oxford University Press official Oxford 3000 PDF word/POS observations on 2026-10-29, one-based PDF pages and zero-based extracted lines. No publisher exact-sense CEFR classification or independent linguistic approval. The frozen shortlist and production assets are untouched; all twelve remain on editorial hold.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A journey made by travelling in an aircraft.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: လေယာဉ်ခရီးစဉ်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Our flight was delayed because of heavy rain.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent human reviewer: Flight as aircraft journey is aligned in the example; distinguish the trip from the act of flying and ask for independently sourced exact-sense justification for B1 placement. Verify publisher-backed exact sense, fluent Myanmar, original example grammar and CEFR rationale; do not approve from word/POS alone.
